decisions.reason: The renamed 518 FLEX trommel screen has its own page and builds on an established model, so performance likely meets aspirations with little reason for search.
The flail shredder line has its own page and fits the core mobile processing business, so it is likely carried while results mature.
The high-speed grinder line is only mentioned, which signals uncertain traction, but it fits core competences and slack from the established business can carry it for now.

This single stationary electric fine shredder gets only a mention and sits further from the mobile core, making it a candidate for problemistic search, though one year is too short to judge it against aspirations.
The green-waste grinder line overlaps with Product C and has low visibility, so consolidation is possible, but it serves the core composting and biomass customers.
The stationary pre-shredder line has its own page and supports the push toward plant-based solutions, so it is likely retained.
